manuscript_title: py-CIPro: Exact geometry of complete-intersection Calabi–Yau threefolds

cover.alt_text: CICY3 records 7626 and 7635 share Hodge numbers (3, 47), Euler characteristic minus 88, and cubic and Chern gcds (2, 2, 2, 4). Their displayed configuration matrices give ambient index gcds of two and one. The first record has only even indices. The third hyperplane on the second record has index five. Across 7,868 non-product records, two gcds give 36 signatures, four give 50, and including the index gcd gives 51. A total of 138 records have index gcd greater than one.

chern-audit.caption: Polarized degrees and Chern pairings from the exact archive audit. (A) Hexagons group 7,868 non-product presentations by the degree $V$ and pairing $T$ defined in [@eq:polarized_pairings]. The degree axis and color count are logarithmic. (B) One point per distinct $(V,T)$ within the modal Hodge pair. Marker area and color increase with the number of represented records. The highlighted IDs attain the minimum and maximum index at the chosen polarization in that Hodge group.
chern-audit.alt_text: Hexagonal count plot of polarized Chern pairings and a scatter plot highlighting index extremes at one Hodge pair.

cicy3-atlas.caption: Hodge coordinates and the discrete Euler distribution. (A) Each point is one of 265 recorded pairs among 7,868 non-product presentations. Color and marker area give the record multiplicity on a logarithmic scale. The bicubic and quintic identify the independently computed fixtures in [@tbl:geometry_fixtures]. (B) Each bar counts one exact stored Euler value across all 7,890 presentations. The dashed line marks the median. Products contribute only to the zero bar. The archive is treated as a finite census, so the counts have no sampling error bars.
cicy3-atlas.alt_text: Hodge-pair scatter with multiplicities and a frequency chart of Euler characteristics.

cicy3-multiplicity.caption: Concentration of recorded Hodge pairs in the non-product catalog. The cumulative curve ranks pairs by decreasing presentation multiplicity and shows the resulting share of 7,868 records against a dashed equal-weight reference. The distribution panel bins the 265 pairs by how many times they occur. Each pair contributes once to that histogram. The figure excludes the product placeholder and uses exact finite-catalog counts.
cicy3-multiplicity.alt_text: Rank concentration of Hodge-pair frequencies and pair counts by multiplicity.

cicy3-structure.caption: Configuration shape and released favorability flags. The shape panel counts all 7,890 presentations by number of ambient factors and number of defining equations. Color shows the cell count on a logarithmic scale. The flag panel groups 7,868 non-product presentations by ambient factor count and displays the fraction flagged favorable in each group. The group counts give the denominators. Light gray shape cells denote absence from this release.
cicy3-structure.alt_text: Configuration matrix shape heatmap beside favorability fractions by ambient rank.

atlas-comparison.caption: Sensitivity of the non-product archive to the unit of counting. (A) Cumulative Euler shares under the two measures. The bracket marks the largest absolute difference on the archived Euler support. (B) Share of total weight at each ambient factor count. (C) Flagged share conditional on ambient factor count under either measure. (D) Ambient composition, within-group, and net changes in the pooled flagged share in percentage points. The complete group denominators and rational weights are preserved in the analysis data.
atlas-comparison.alt_text: Two Euler distribution steps, two ambient-factor profiles, and a signed decomposition of the change in archived favorability.

integral-invariants.caption: Cubic and second Chern content in the released CIPro archive. (A) Occupied cells show exact counts for the 36 observed pairs among 7,868 non-product configurations, with a logarithmic color scale. The axes show the occupied integer levels for each invariant. Empty cells have zero records. (B) Two rank-one ample complete intersections share their Hodge pair and Euler characteristic and have different content on the full integral second cohomology. The degrees and record IDs trace both computations to the release.
integral-invariants.alt_text: Divisibility of cubic intersections and second Chern pairings on ambient divisor lattices, with breakdowns by Hodge pair.

line-bundle-cohomology.caption: Independent line-bundle tests and native cohomology domains. The quintic panel plots $h^0$ and $-h^3$ on a symmetric logarithmic scale for $|k|\le10$. They agree with independent binomial counts, with the two intermediate dimensions zero throughout and the index shown by the dashed curve. The bicubic panel classifies native results for integer pairs with $|a|,|b|\le8$. Circles and triangles indicate $H^0$ and $H^3$ only, and grow with the dimension on a log scale. Squares mark acyclic results and crosses mark unsupported inputs. The separately computed index is verified on the entire grid.
line-bundle-cohomology.alt_text: Quintic line-bundle dimensions and supported and unsupported charge regions of the bicubic.

bicubic-exact.caption: Paired cohomology jumps on the smooth bicubic of [@def:sparse_bicubic]. Panel A maps the excess in each of $H^1$ and $H^2$ over the generic dimensions from [@eq:bicubic_paired_excess]. The nonlinear color scale is inverse-hyperbolic-sine, with its ticks in dimension units. The dashed line is the zero-index slice $b=-a$, and the ring marks the rank witness in [@thm:bicubic_jump]. Panel B shows the two signed middle-degree contributions to the index along the positive-$a$ half of the slice. On this slice $h^0=h^3=0$, so the two bars cancel at every charge.
bicubic-exact.alt_text: Exact bicubic cohomology in a specified smooth member and its excess over the generic formula.
